# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_RSI_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the market opens with a bullish bias above VWAP and then pulls back to VWAP with an oversold RSI, a mean‑reversion bounce is likely. This edge exists because institutional algorithms often defend VWAP as a fair value reference, and short-term overextensions (RSI<30) tend to revert to the mean during the morning session when liquidity is establishing.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If the first 30‑min bar's high > VWAP and any subsequent 5‑min bar within the first 90 minutes closes within 0.1% of VWAP while RSI(14) on that bar < 30, enter long at the bar's close. Exit shape: Initial stop at the low of the opening range (ORL) or 0.5% below entry, whichever is tighter; target 1.5× risk or trail using a 10‑bar chandelier exit. Regime hint: Best when VIX < 15 and during the first 2 hours after open; avoid when VIX > 22 or during major news windows (first 15 min after 9:30).
